**What problem does this solve?**
The use case or limitation you are hitting.

**Proposed solution**
What you would like to see (an estimator, an API, a diagnostic). If it is an estimator, please
link the paper.

**Method and implementation provenance**
Classify the request, if known, as a paper-defined method, a paper-derived composition,
project-defined work, external reference code, or a request for which no implementation exists.
Link the primary paper and authors' or independent reference code separately. **“New in pid-rs”
means implementation, API, composition, diagnostic, or engineering work new to this repository; it
is not a claim of scientific novelty.** Check
[`METHODS.md`](https://github.com/sepahead/pid-rs/blob/main/METHODS.md) and
[`method-catalog.json`](https://github.com/sepahead/pid-rs/blob/main/method-catalog.json), and note
whether
`python3 scripts/check-method-catalog.py` would require a new or changed entry.
